content:
Training gallery and milestones

In-product training flow with badges/progress (currently backed by local storage with a path to server-side rewards—see engineering handoff docs).

What this is

The training gallery tracks optional training tasks, badges, and milestones. Progress may live in local storage today with a path to server-backed rewards in future releases.

How to use it

  • Open the gallery from the assistant header menu when available.
  • Complete suggested training flows to unlock badges.
  • Revisit after product updates; new tasks may appear.

Notes and limits

Uninstalling the profile clears local progress unless synced by a future server feature.
